_comment: Copy this file to local.settings.json and fill in real values. local.settings.json is gitignored.

Values._comment_deadletter: Storage Queue buffers failed records for retry against the Dataverse error table. AzureWebJobsStorage above is the connection used for the QueueTrigger. In Azure, prefer identity-based binding: set AzureWebJobsStorage__queueServiceUri = https://<storage-account>.queue.core.windows.net and grant the Function App's Managed Identity 'Storage Queue Data Contributor' on the storage account.
Values._comment_appinsights: Optional. When unset the app runs fine and telemetry is discarded. Set it to start seeing traces/dependencies/exceptions in the Application Insights resource. Format: InstrumentationKey=<guid>;IngestionEndpoint=https://<region>.applicationinsights.azure.com/;...
